newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group gasoline up on squeeze.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group gasoline up on squeeze.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials firmed sharply in Group Three on Wednesday as sellers squeezed some buyers seeking late-month barrels, traders said.
"There's a short squeeze going on in the Group," one trader said of pressure pushing differentials higher since late yesterday.
"They're just getting their clock cleaned," another Group trader said of the unidentified buyers seeking late-month unleaded.
The squeeze was tied to shipping delays on the Houston-to-Chicago Explorer pipeline system that have left some players short on late-month product.
Traders also said talk was muted by Tenneco's annual outing in Houston which took many regional traders out of the market, and a Group Three outing that starts on Thursday.
"If they don't get it cut, there won't be anyone home," one trader said of pressure on the buyers.
Group Three unleaded was bid 0.25 cent a gallon below the print for late-April deliveries, up nearly two cents a gallon over the past day, traders said.
In Chicago, where trade has shifted to May deliveries, unleaded was talked 0.75/0.50 cent under June NYMEX unleaded.
